findings.title: Clear toolchain override environment variables
findings.text: The comment claims the environment cannot change codegen, but `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` (and `RUSTC`/`RUSTC_WRAPPER`, `CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_*`) still override the pinned `rust-toolchain.toml` and release codegen. An inherited `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN` would silently build the released binary with a different toolchain, breaking the pin.

findings.title: Harden cleanup against interruptions
findings.text: `cleanup` runs under `set -e`, and the INT/TERM/HUP traps are still armed while it runs, so a failure or second signal in the middle of cleanup can abort it and violate the "no temp dir left behind / exact exit code" contract. Disable errexit and reset all traps before doing the removal work.

findings.title: Make asset publication atomic
findings.text: The "never overwrite" guarantee is only a TOCTOU pre-check: `mv` replaces an existing `$out/$1` unconditionally, so a concurrent release can silently pair one run's tarball with another run's checksum. Publish with a hardlink (which fails if the name exists) and clean the temp file, preserving a pinned checksum atomically.
